_meta.data_freshness: Program existence, type, chain/ecosystem, region, and dilution posture are evergreen and verified through June 2026. TIME-SENSITIVE fields (application deadlines, open/closed cohort status, current prize pool / check size, cadence) are baseline snapshots and MUST be re-verified live before the user applies or acts.
_meta.coverage: Global. Every entry is region-tagged. Southeast Asia / Vietnam-relevant entries carry sea_relevant: true.

opportunities.name: a16z Crypto Startup Accelerator (CSX)
opportunities.notes: Intensive multi-week program from a16z crypto. Network-heavy, founder-friendly. Check the official page for the next cohort window.

opportunities.name: Alliance DAO
opportunities.notes: Applications for cohort ALL19 (starting Jan 11, 2027) have an early deadline of September 23, 2026 and a regular deadline of November 18, 2026. Rolling review.

opportunities.name: Outlier Ventures Base Camp
opportunities.notes: Often called the "YC of Web3"; 300+ startups accelerated. "Post-Web" thesis (internet for humans and machines). Token-launch and go-to-market focus.

opportunities.name: TachyonX (formerly Tachyon Accelerator)
opportunities.notes: Successor to the Tachyon accelerator, run by Consensys Mesh with a focus on AI and Crypto. Operates on a rolling admission basis, but review of new applications is paused until Fall 2026.

opportunities.name: YZi Labs (formerly Binance Labs)
opportunities.notes: EASY Residency Season 5 applications are open until September 13, 2026.

opportunities.name: Base ecosystem grants (Coinbase / Base)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: 1-5 ETH for builder grants, 2 ETH weekly for weekly rewards
opportunities.notes: Funding is primarily through the Base Ecosystem Fund and a programmatic reward system via the Base Dashboard and Builder Codes.

opportunities.name: Colosseum Eternal (Solana accelerator)
opportunities.notes: The 'Eternal' track is open for rolling applications until Sep 9, 2026. Next main hackathon is Fall 2026 (Sep 28-Nov 2).

opportunities.name: Draper University Web3 / Crypto programs
opportunities.notes: Cardano's 'Genesis' pre-accelerator applications for the Aug-Sep 2026 cohort are closed. However, applications for the general Hero Training Fall 2026 session (Oct 11 - Nov 15) are open.

opportunities.name: Antler (Web3 track)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Pre-seed check (typically equity) after the residency
opportunities.notes: No dedicated 'Web3 track', but Web3 is a core part of its general residencies. London applications are open for Sep 22 cohort. Singapore intake is Oct 5.

opportunities.name: Founders, Inc. (f.inc)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Space, resources, and investment for some teams
opportunities.notes: The 'Off Season' residency for summer 2026 concluded on Aug 7. Applications for specific programs like Artifact, Canopy, and Blueprint open seasonally, but rolling applications for a two-week campus residency are available year-round.

opportunities.name: Ethereum Foundation Ecosystem Support Program (ESP)
opportunities.notes: The EF is restructuring, but the ESP continues to fund core protocol security and public goods. Q3 2026 cycle is in progress.

opportunities.name: Arbitrum Foundation Grants
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: ARB grants, milestone-based; tiered amounts (incl. focused funds like Trailblazer)
opportunities.notes: Multiple programs are active, including the main Foundation Grant Program, Domain Allocator Offerings (Season 3), and various incentive programs.

opportunities.name: Optimism Grants (proactive)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: OP token grants via Collective grant programs
opportunities.notes: Season 9 is ending, and the Grants Council is proposed to be dissolved. The grants process is being restructured. Retro Funding is paused until 2027.

opportunities.name: Web3 Foundation Grants (Polkadot / Kusama)
opportunities.notes: Grants program is active and accepting applications. Focus is on Polkadot 2.0 (JAM) infrastructure.

opportunities.name: Interchain Foundation Grants (Cosmos)
opportunities.notes: Funding applications are managed via apply.interchain.io. The main website provides information on funding philosophy and past recipients.

opportunities.name: NEAR Foundation Grants / Ecosystem funding
opportunities.notes: Funding is now decentralized through the NEAR Infrastructure Committee and various community DAOs (DeveloperDAO, MarketingDAO, etc.).

opportunities.name: Sui Foundation Grants
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Milestone-based grants for Sui ecosystem projects
opportunities.notes: The Foundation offers multiple programs including Developer Grants, RFPs, and Academic Research Awards via its funding portal.

opportunities.name: Filecoin / Protocol Labs Grants
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Open grants up to $50k and RFPs; milestone-based
opportunities.notes: FIL-ProPGF Batch 3 is in its final onboarding phase. Foundation Open Grants and Next Step Grants are open. Protocol Labs Research Grants are paused.

opportunities.name: ETHGlobal (hackathon series)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Per-event prize pools (commonly $200K+) across sponsor tracks
opportunities.cadence: multiple in-person + online events per year
opportunities.notes: Upcoming events: ETHOnline (Sep 4-16), ETHGlobal Tokyo (Sep 25-27), ETHGlobal Mumbai (Nov 6-8).

opportunities.name: Colosseum Solana Hackathons (Frontier, etc.)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Large prize pools + $250k investment into top teams via Eternal
opportunities.notes: The next hackathon is Fall 2026, running from Sep 28 to Nov 2.

opportunities.name: DoraHacks (global hackathon + BUIDL platform)
opportunities.notes: Multiple hackathons are active in July 2026, including WTF!! Summer Edition, HashKey Chain On-Chain Horizon, and others.

opportunities.name: Polkadot ecosystem hackathons
opportunities.notes: The official Build Polkadot Network site lists current hackathons and builder initiatives. Many official hackathons are hosted via DoraHacks or Encode Club.

opportunities.name: Gitcoin Grants & Bounties
opportunities.notes: The platform has transitioned from seasonal rounds to 'Gitcoin 3.0', a continuous funding model with domain-specific campaigns (e.g., the 'd/acc' initiative). Monitor the official site for active, targeted funding opportunities.

opportunities.name: Immunefi (security bug bounties)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Bug-bounty payouts (up to millions for critical findings)
opportunities.notes: Platform is active and has paid out over $140M lifetime. Top bounties include Uniswap v4 ($15.5M) and Sky ($10M).

opportunities.name: Optimism Retro Funding (RetroPGF)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: OP rewards distributed for proven ecosystem impact
opportunities.notes: The Retro Funding program is paused until 2027 for a strategic reevaluation.

opportunities.name: Drips (continuous retroactive dependency funding)
opportunities.notes: Stellar Wave 8 is expected to launch around August 23, 2026. A legacy contract was exploited on July 14, but the main platform is operational.

opportunities.name: Ethereum Protocol Fellowship (EPF)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Stipend + mentorship to contribute to Ethereum core protocol
opportunities.notes: Applications for the 2026 cohort (EPF7) closed on May 13, 2026. The program runs from June to November 2026. Applications for the next cohort are expected in Spring 2027.

opportunities.name: Solana ecosystem developer fellowships / bootcamps
opportunities.notes: The Solana Foundation and ecosystem partners (Superteam, MLH, Encode Club) run various bootcamps and fellowships. Check the main developer portal for current programs.

opportunities.name: Sky Mavis / Ronin ecosystem grants
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Ecosystem grants for games/apps on Ronin
opportunities.notes: The Ronin Forge Innovation Grant is the primary program. The new Proof of Distribution model provides continuous, performance-based rewards.

opportunities.name: Kyros Ventures / Coin98 ecosystem programs
opportunities.notes: GM Vietnam 2025 has been announced. The Web3 Matching program is ongoing. Coin98 has active campaigns like 'Wallet Health'.

opportunities.name: Hashed Emergent (India / SEA)
opportunities.notes: Applications for Hashed Vibe Haus (Edition 2) are open. India Blockchain Week 2026 is in November.

opportunities.name: Tribe Accelerator (Singapore)
opportunities.notes: Applications for the Kumihimo Tech Camp (MedTech) closed on July 31, 2026. The Ignition AI Accelerator is an ongoing program. Check the website for future general cohort applications.

opportunities.name: sqrDAO builder programs & bounties (Vietnam / SEA)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Community bounties, hackathon support, and builder programs
opportunities.notes: The flagship Web3 Builders' Summit (LFBUIDL) for 2026 was held in May. The DAO continues to run builder programs (sqrBUIDL), bounties, and community events on a continuous basis.

opportunities.name: Superteam Vietnam (Solana)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Bounties, grants, and hackathon support for Solana builders
opportunities.notes: The 'Bring Your Web2 Ideas Onchain' bounty is closed, but multiple other bounties (e.g., Agentic Engineering Grants, Touching Grass Fund) are available on Superteam Earn.

opportunities.name: Corelia Academy (Vietnam Web3 education)
opportunities.notes: Site is live and running programs; latest UniHackfest 2026 post 24 Jul 2026 (Hanoi Campus). The domain is bot-protected — it returns 403 to plain fetchers but 200 in a browser, so do not mark it dead on a failed automated fetch. Exact UniHackfest phase/deadline unverified.

opportunities.name: VBI Academy (Vietnam Blockchain Innovation Academy)
opportunities.notes: The Digital Assets Literacy 2026 program runs through July/August. The NextX 2026 startup series is also active.

opportunities.name: UniHackfest (Vietnam national student hackathon)
opportunities.notes: Idea submission is open from July 15 to Aug 18 for the 2026 edition.

opportunities.name: RMIT Vietnam FinTech Club / Hack-A-Venture
opportunities.notes: Hack-A-Venture 2025 concluded in Jan 2026. The 2026 edition is expected to be announced in Q4 2026.

opportunities.name: HUST BK Fintech Hackday
opportunities.notes: Season 13 (UniHackfest 2026 Hanoi Campus) is running from July 15, with an idea submission deadline of Aug 18, 2026.

opportunities.name: Vietnam Aptos Hackathon (DoraHacks)
opportunities.notes: Expected to be part of GM Vietnam in August 2026. Official dates not yet announced.

opportunities.name: VietBUIDL Hackathon
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Large global prize pool (~$4M reported, 2025 edition)
opportunities.notes: The last VietBUIDL Hackathon was in 2025. No 2026 edition has been announced.
